newsitem.title: CHINA: China orders 62 commercial planes in '96 - Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: China orders 62 commercial planes in '96 - Xinhua.

text.p: The Civil Aviation General Administration of China placed orders for 62 commercial planes with foreign aircraft manufacturers in 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The planes would be delivered before the year 2000, Xinhua said without giving a breakdown of the suppliers or buyers.
It also did not say how much the planes cost.
China took delivery of 34 planes in 1996, including 21 Boeing aircraft, seven Airbus, three McDonnell Douglas and three domestically made planes, Xinhua said.
It said the number of deliveries was "not more" compared with previous years, but there were more new models.
The agency gave no further details.
